EA is a complex and challenging task, and the quality of its products and services is a key factor in its successful implementation.

the quality of EA products and services is influenced by a combination of ten quality attributes, and that these attributes can be grouped into four categories: (1) EA content, (2) EA process, (3) EA people and (4) EA technology.

the quality of the EA product and service is dependent on a set of attributes that can be categorized as follows: (i) the ability to meet business needs, (ii) the quality of the architecture itself, (iii) the quality of EA management and (iv) the ability to support change.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EA quality is a multidimensional concept, with a set of attributes that are both product- and service-oriented.
EA quality is an important factor for the success of EA initiatives, and that the identified attributes should be used to assess and improve EA products and services.

the quality of EA products and services is not only dependent on the quality of the underlying models and artifacts, but also on the quality of processes and the quality of the people who create and maintain them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single quality attribute for EA.
EA quality attributes should be considered in the design and evaluation of EA products and services.
EA quality is an important topic for EA practitioners, as well as researchers, and that EA quality is a complex and multi-faceted concept.
